components.name: Toast
components.description:
Figma Toast-Message (1579:13276): Corner-Radius/2XLarge surface with Effect/Popover, padding Medium/Large,
gap Medium; the Body groups the Title/Caption stack (gap 3XSmall) with the action (gap XSmall).
Subtle is the Popover surface with a 1px OUTSIDE Border/Popover/Subtle stroke.

props.name: status
props.deprecated: Use type: success → positive, error → negative (warning and info are the same).

props.name: icon
props.description: `true` (default) shows the type's icon, `false` hides it; an icon name or a node replaces it.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the close control. Default: the locale's “Dismiss”.

components.name: ToastStack
components.description:
Toast queue with motion: new toasts rise in (Slow, emphasized), leaving toasts fade/scale out while their row
collapses (Base, exit curve) so the stack reflows smoothly. Portals through ZenPortal; aria-live is on each Toast.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Called when a toast times out or its close button is pressed; remove it from `toasts`.

props.name: duration
props.description: Default auto-dismiss (ms). Toasts with an action get +3s. Timers pause while the stack is hovered or focused.

props.name: max
props.description: Most toasts shown at once; older ones are dismissed.

props.name: inline
props.description: Render in place (e.g. inside a demo card) instead of the fixed viewport layer.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Accessible name of every toast's close button (a toast's own `closeLabel` wins). Default: the locale's “Dismiss”.

components.name: ToastProvider
components.description:
Owns the toast queue and renders one ToastStack. ZenProvider already includes it (outermost provider), so apps
only call useToast(); render ToastProvider yourself only outside a ZenProvider.

props.name: duration
props.description: Default auto-dismiss in ms (toasts with an action get +3s).

props.name: max
props.description: Most toasts on screen at once.
